name: [HIGH] CVE-2026-78409
statusMessage: util-linux: util-linux: X-mount.subdir detached-tree resolution can escape via intermediate symlinks
statusTrace: The X-mount.subdir option uses a detached-tree fast path on Linux 6.15 and later and passes the configured subdirectory to open_tree() with AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW. That flag does not stop intermediate symlink traversal or keep resolution inside the newly mounted filesystem. A local unprivileged user with an fstab-authorized X-mount.subdir entry can attach a host path at the intended mountpoint.
